episode.episodeDescription: Jimmy Donaldson, better known as MrBeast, is a YouTuber, entrepreneur, and philanthropist. He is the founder of Beast Industries and Beast Philanthropy, and the creator and host of the Prime Video competition series “Beast Games.”www.beastgames.comwww.beastphilanthropy.orgwww.youtube.com/@MrBeast Learn more about your ad choices. transcript_window.text: I was like, dude, this guy would be a cool guest.
We were talking about these temples in India, and I've been down these multiple rabbit holes about these temples that they carved out of a single – 2009, there were 69 ,000 podcasts.
That just means 69 – in Apple's directory.
So that means roughly 70 ,000 people had done one at some point.
But then, yeah, I would wager a small percentage were actually active at the time.
Now, in 2026, how many podcasts are there?
Yeah, actually, I'm going to up mine to 10 million.
So since 2009, there were 69 ,000 versus several million shows today, depending on the database you look at.
But what is the number, though?
